Params: In darkness and silence, you return once more to the familiar quantum sea, immersed in a peaceful yet somber dream.
Surging memories rush in to wake you... You hear static as the past and present merge into one.
In the endless cycles, what possibility are you searching for?
A sea of corruption, a blackened sky, your formless existence, and this endlessly repeating world...
Your consciousness refuses to linger here any longer. You will ignite yourself and paint the sea's surface with ashen flames.
In the flickering flames of karma, a white portal fades in and out, as if silently echoing the answer in your heart.
As you open your weary eyes, the portal opens before you.
This path leads to yet another parallel universe—where your final journey shall unfold.
You remember standing here with Jetavie countless times before. Having defeated the Image of Desire—your archenemy—the two of you were here waiting for time to reset...
Now, you are no longer part of the scene but an<color=#ff0e0e>observer</color>, silently watching this timeline unfold.
You hear a woman's voice—gentle, calm, and enchanting. She speaks quietly of her desires...
Her veiled malice flows by your ears like water, leaving you intoxicated and helpless.
Be it lamb, wolf, or cheetah...
Beings that make the survival of their species their ultimate goal will inevitably fall into degradation once they lose their natural predators.
They crumble beyond salvation from within and become pawns cast aside by God.
Awakening is both a duty and a price to be paid.
You see, I cherish you as my own, which is why I hope you become the Chosen One more than anyone else.
Bringing in that virus and trapping you in this endless cycle—are all proofs of my love.
Perhaps, one day, you will rise above all other possibilities through this surging malice.
Just like 3278 cycles ago when you devoured the Chosen One's computing power...
You look just as adorable as you point your gun at me now.
You must never stop fighting, Jetavie.
I'm going to finish you here and now, Higher Authority!
The view shifts to reveal a silver-haired girl standing amid piles of butchered monsters. She stands defiant with her battered body. Her icy glare shows only a ruthless thirst for blood.
Jetavie is every bit as innocent and cheerful as you remember her...
My name is Jetavie. Our meeting here is not by chance.
On a second look, while she looks the same, her presence is entirely different. This girl is more mature, like a battle-hardened avenger. Her unkempt silver hair flows wild, and...
The weapon in her hand looks like something between a gun and a cannon.
You suddenly realize—in this universe, Jetavie has lost the Chosen One.
As for why... maybe somewhere along the way, their shared desire to live has faded...
They promised to find freedom together, but was "together" ever truly possible?
If only one of them could escape, then staying here might be the only way for them to remain together.
The thought "I want to stay together,"" inevitably turned into ""I don't want to leave."
Doubts gradually eroded their judgment, and their growing comfort with the status quo hindered their quest for freedom.
And the one who first realized this and broke their unspoken agreement was likely your counterpart in this timeline...
The Chosen One willingly sacrificed themselves to sever their bond and rekindle Jetavie's resolve to escape the matrix.
That gun in Jetavie's hand must have been crafted from the Chosen One's remaining computing power.
Enough talking. As long as I am still alive...
Jetavie tightens her grip on the trigger as new enemies burst out from the ground around her.
A horde of monsters materializes from scattered data and lunges at Jetavie.
Darn it. Now of all time, huh...
Jetavie has no choice but to reposition her weapon, turning its barrel away from Higher Authority and toward the approaching monsters.
Crimson light erupts and carves a clean hole through a monster's body.
But more monsters come charging in, wave after wave.
Jetavie swings her weapon violently, unleashing rays in all directions in a desperate fight.
When is it going to end...
Jetavie strikes down her final enemy as her weapon reaches its limit.
Mangled remains scatter at Jetavie's feet.
When Jetavie raises her gun at Higher Authority once more...
I never thought it'd be possible for you.
You've grown much stronger after absorbing the Chosen One's remaining computing power.
But it's far from enough. How much computing power could you really gain from a shattered soul?
A hint of melancholy creeps into her voice.
Shut up! Give the Chosen One back to me!
Give the Chosen One back to you? How can I give them back when you're the one who devoured the Chosen One.
A destroyed body can be rebuilt in another cycle of reincarnation, but once the computing power that forms the soul is lost...
I'm afraid there's nothing I can do.
Do you want me to extract the Chosen One's computing power from your body like a surgeon?
But you two were always meant to be one entity. To put it bluntly, you're simply more complete now than you were before.
Stop making assumptions! You don't know anything about us!
Whining at me like a lovesick teenager is going to get you nowhere.
You're always the last one standing when everyone else is gone.
You appear in every cycle, just like me and the Chosen One... No, you are an existence that transcends even us.
This is why I am Higher Authority. Is that hard to comprehend?
You're my true enemy. Defeating you will give me all the answers I seek.
Do you think the truth will just reveal itself if you defeat me? But what if the truth is a poison?
I don't care. The truth is all I seek.
Are you sure you're not just deluding yourself, Jetavie?
How did you feel when the Chosen One entrusted their computing power to you?
Pain? Moved? Pity? Or did you blame yourself for being powerless?
If I were you, I'd probably be overjoyed.
Finally reclaiming what should have been yours, finally ridding yourself of that useless burden...
Now that you've inherited their projection abilities, you don't have to rely on anyone else in a fight, right?
Shut up! How dare you insult the Chosen One! If it weren't for you—!
If it weren't for you... we'd never have been dragged into this twisted cycle you call a game, and the Chosen One would still have been alive.
I know you're the one behind everything.
You're neither one of us, nor a monster born from the Red Tide.
Maybe I'm a pink-haired girl in platform shoes.
Maybe I'm a man sitting in a dark corner after losing his prosthetic limb.
Maybe I'm a blind witch sheltering others beneath a tree.
Maybe I'm Sheriff Robert, who upholds justice and fights evil.
If you wish, I could be anyone you want. Even this "me" you see now is but an illusion.
No matter who you are, no matter how many cycles it takes, I will catch you and make you pay.
Don't hate me, Jetavie. Why glare at me with such fury over a worthless Job?
Besides, you're running out of time.
This world, too, will soon end.
Like a bubble fated for doom.
Dark patches, like curtains, appear at the edge of the horizon.
The dark patches spread in all directions as the claws of the void begin to devour the world whole.
Under the collapsing heavens, Jetavie charges toward Higher Authority's vanishing figure.
Give me back... the Chosen One!
Higher Authority snaps her fingers with casual grace.
Hordes of monsters surge forth from the murky ground, swarming and holding down Jetavie.
The hideous enemies desperately press on Jetavie's head and drag her into a sea of debris and wreckage.
Jetavie is quickly buried beneath the debris. Only her fingertip can be seen on the surface.
On the other side, the void drowns the world in a grey-white whirlpool, making it as fragile as a tower about to collapse.
Higher Authority suddenly freezes in her tracks.
Higher Authority turns her gaze toward you, despite your intangible existence.
Terror strikes your soul in that instant. You feel a hand choking you—although the hand seems to have no physical form.
Higher Authority has a small change of mind.
If this is one possibility... this would truly be a delightful coincidence.
As Higher Authority turns around, the monsters around Jetavie instantly crumble to ashes.
Jetavie collapses to the ground covered in wounds, yet her willpower drives her to prop herself up once more.
Cracks of darkness appear behind Higher Authority like a spiderweb, and from it a pale blue bow and arrow emerge.
I shall grant you access to a higher level of authority.
Power you've never had before—a gift powerful enough to change everything.
—The power to turn back time itself.
The blue arrow suddenly shoots out from the crack, piercing straight through Jetavie's body.
Jetavie lets out an agonized scream as pale blue markings begin to creep across her body and face.
Ahh! Curse you, woman! What have you done to me?!
...Is my internal processing power expanding at an incredible speed?
Why are you helping me? Aren't we enemies...
The possibility you seek exists neither in this moment nor in this place.
The answer does exist—if that resolution is what you seek...
There's a faint trace of sorrow in the way Higher Authority looks.
I shall wait for you at the <color=#ff0e0e>beginning</color> of your journey.
With these words, Higher Authority vanishes into the unknown through the mysterious void crack.
Left without so much as a goodbye.
This power from Higher Authority... what exactly is it?
As Jetavie surveys her surroundings, the colors of the world ebb away like receding tides.
A raging void storm sweeps through every corner, leaving Jetavie alone in the eye of the tempest.
The surging computational power within Jetavie is driving her to make a choice.
The enemy's power? How absurd! But what choice do I have...
The Chosen One, I will try once more—even if this is a trap, even if this power isn't truly mine...
Even if nothing remains here, for your sake, I will revive time itself from death.
Let time halt at this very moment, and everything that has passed flows backward...
Time... has come to a halt...
The apocalypse freezes at this moment—the storm ceases, and even the light filtering through the ashen sky comes to a standstill.
[Rollback Protocol Ready, Constructing Multi-Branch Simulation Data...]
[Rollback Protocol Ready, Constructing Multi-Branch Simulation Data...]
[Multiple Variables Destabilizing... Threat Assessment... Level S]
I'll keep rewinding, no matter how long it takes, and return to the past.
I will hold your hand once more...
This time, I will never let you go.
The lost time begins to flow backward.
As the gray sky regains its colors, the void slowly loosens its grip on the world.
The wind flows against the two of you. The clouds sail to the far horizon.
Splattered dirt returns to Earth while withered blooms awaken once more.
Stirring with the flowers is the ancient Red Tide—and the monsters it bred within.
Was it you who awakened me?
Did power awaken from the time that is dead...
The cost is equally apparent... Is your decision final?
I'll be waiting nearby, my dear.
As their archenemy departs, monsters awaken one after another from the Red Tide and head toward the distant unknown.
As time resets, this world known as Beta brims with an ethereal vitality.
No one knows how this repeating cycle of cause and effect will end.
Time is accelerating the entropic increase... causing withered bubbles to swell once more.
All the wounds on Jetavie's body vanish, and her weapon is fully loaded once again.
The girl sets out once more on a solitary journey to redemption.
The shards of your soul shall follow Jetavie's eyes in the journey ahead...
You will be neither a friend nor a foe, only a silent observer.
Please guide Jetavie whenever she reaches a crossroads.
